video.title: Authentication vs Authorization Explained in 1 min! #devops #software

transcript.text: Let's understand the difference between
authentication and authorization.
Authentication. Authentication is a
process of verifying users identity. Who
are you? Are you the right person trying
to access this application or system? So
for example, whenever you log into your
AWS account with your right username and
password, you are authenticated which
means you are the right person with
correct credentials to access this AWS
account. On the other hand,
authorization is about checking what you
can access or what permissions do you
have in the system. For example, in your
AWS account, the admins or root user are
authorized to access everything. Whereas
database admins are only authorized to
use RDS or a particular service. In
short, authentication is confirming who
you are by checking your credentials.
And authorization means what you can do
by checking your permissions. Subscribe.
